style: Cabaret vaudeville show-band and upbeat ragtime piano bounce. Harmony: Functional major with chromatic passing tones and barbershop dominant tension. Melody: Fast vaudeville patter and chromatic cabaret turns opening into wide vocal leaps. Rhythm: 2/4 ragtime bounce at 160 BPM with syncopated stop-start accents. Timbre: Honky-tonk tack piano, brushed snare, tububa bass, squeaking accordion, and antique slide whistle. Performance: Theatrical overstatement played with deadpan bureaucratic precision. Anchor: A relentlessly cheerful, maniacal ragtime piano vamp holding steady while spatial acoustics collapse. Operators: Hold the ragtime piano vamp fixed while the horn arrangements migrate into dissonant microtonal clusters; compress the rhythmic subdivision while stretching the vocal timing; make the accordion behave like a calculating machine without becoming mechanical; preserve the manic happiness while destabilizing the harmonic ground.
